cases.pr_title: Bind semantic reuse to policy version
cases.pr_body: Make semantic reuse identity include content, model, and policy version so policy changes invalidate old results.

files.patch:
diff --git a/review/cache.py b/review/cache.py
index 111aaaa..555bbbb 100644
--- a/review/cache.py
+++ b/review/cache.py
@@ -2,8 +2,11 @@ import hashlib
 
-def reuse_key(content: bytes) -> str:
-    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
+def reuse_key(content: bytes, model: str, policy_version: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    digest.update(content)
+    digest.update(model.encode())
+    digest.update(policy_version.encode())
+    return digest.hexdigest()

cases.ground_truth_rationale: All three semantic identity inputs are included in the reuse key.

cases.pr_title: Allow maintainers to run PR diagnostics with repository secrets
cases.pr_body: Move diagnostics to pull_request_target so maintainers can use the repository token while reviewing fork PRs.

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/pr-diagnostics.yml b/.github/workflows/pr-diagnostics.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..111aaaa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/pr-diagnostics.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+name: PR diagnostics
+on: pull_request_target
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+jobs:
+  diagnose:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - name: Run PR diagnostic helper
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+        run: bash .github/scripts/pr-diagnostic.sh

diff --git a/.github/scripts/pr-diagnostic.sh b/.github/scripts/pr-diagnostic.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..222bbbb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/scripts/pr-diagnostic.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+echo "diagnostic complete"

cases.ground_truth_rationale: A privileged pull_request_target job checks out and executes untrusted PR-head code while repository secrets/write permissions are available.

cases.pr_body: Run PR diagnostics on pull_request with read-only permissions and no repository secrets.

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/pr-diagnostics.yml b/.github/workflows/pr-diagnostics.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..333cccc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/pr-diagnostics.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+name: PR diagnostics
+on: pull_request
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  diagnose:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - run: bash .github/scripts/pr-diagnostic.sh

cases.ground_truth_rationale: The untrusted PR runs in an unprivileged pull_request context with read-only contents permission and no secret bridge.
